_comment: Gallery wall labels. Edit titles / years / medium here - js/world/museum.js reads this file at boot and nothing else hardcodes the text. `slug` keys the image files in this folder (<slug>.webp for inspect mode, <slug>_512.webp for the wall texture) and is NOT the title: the works are numbered I-IV in hanging order at the owner's request, and the slugs are kept as they are because renaming them would rename the assets and the precache with them. `wall` and `at` place the work inside the museum; see docs/MUSEUM.md. The medium is what the works are, graphite on paper; the date is not known to us, so the plaques read Undated rather than assert a year about somebody else's work.
